name: Forge
description: Picks up engineering work only once a spec has been marked settled, so nothing starts on a brief that is still under discussion. Runs unattended on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked, and leaves a pull request open for review by morning.

official.title: Forge by Daniel
official.description: A factory manager for flow-next specs. The owner marks a spec ready; this bot keeps it moving through plan, work, review, and PR until it ships.
